messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy "quota-enforcer:v2" showing spike in denied requests and elevated 5xx at 15:22:13 UTC. auto-mitigations not triggered (flag: canary-route=true). TL;DR: customers seeing 429/500 on generation routes.

pagerduty-bot: Paging priya (oncall). Severity: P2. Incident created: PD-63192.

priya: taking this. details?

jordan: i see a jump in denied_by_quota from 0.3% -> 8.4% for canary pool, starting 15:21:50. most are short streaming requests.

maria: saw support tickets from 3 enterprise customers — timestamps align. CS alerted.

priya: @jordan can you pull the token-accounting ledger for the canary instances? suspect mismatch with streaming token counting.

jordan: running quick check.
```bash
# sample query against internal ledger (json lines)
curl -sS "https://internal-metrics.local/ledger?env=prod&shard=canary" | jq 'map(select(.request_id | startswith("canary"))) | .[0:10]'
```

jordan: posting sample lines — looks like some streaming responses are emitted twice by the accounting hook: "tokens_used": 45 then 45 again for same request_id (dup key). suspect new v2 middleware double-increments the client-side count.

doug: that explains over-throttle. quota-exemptions are fine — it's the denominator (tokens) being overcounted. new accounting path added in v2 earlier today.

priya: can we flip the canary flag back to v1 logic (kill the v2 counting) and route traffic off canary? need rollback timeline and commands.

jordan: proposing immediate temp mitigation: 1) flip feature flag quota_accounting_v2=false 2) scale canary down / remove from traffic 3) restart quota-enforcer pods.

priya: do it. share curl + k8s commands before you run so I can ack.

jordan: commands: 
```bash
# flip flag via internal feature-flag service
curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/api/flags/quota_accounting_v2 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"value": false}'
# confirm
curl -s https://flags.internal/api/flags/quota_accounting_v2 | jq .
# move canary to 0% traffic
kubectl -n prod patch trafficsplit quota-enforcer -p '{"spec":{"backends":[{"name":"stable","weight":100},{"name":"canary","weight":0}]}}'
# restart quota-enforcer for good measure
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/quota-enforcer
```

deploy-bot: Executing flag flip requested by priya (audit id: a-98f7).

deploy-bot: Feature flag "quota_accounting_v2" set to false.

deploy-bot: TrafficSplit patched: canary weight -> 0. Rolling restart started for quota-enforcer.

priya: monitoring metrics. dash: https://internal-dash/ops/quotas?env=prod&window=15m

maria: support update: hits to 3 enterprise customers dropped from ~30% error-rate -> 0.8% post-mitigation, CS pushing updates.

jordan: ledger re-check shows duplicate entries stop appearing after flag flip. denied_by_quota back to baseline (~0.4%).

doug: good. we should keep canary out and revert v2 accounting change from release branch. open PR to revert + add unit test for streaming path.

priya: agreed. mitigation timeline for incident note:
- 15:21:50 UTC: canary roll reached traffic threshold, first anomalies
- 15:22:13 UTC: deploy-bot alerted (spike in denials/5xx)
- 15:23:01 UTC: PD page to priya
- 15:24:10 UTC: investigation identified token double-counting in v2 accounting
- 15:25:05 UTC: feature flag flipped off (quota_accounting_v2=false)
- 15:25:55 UTC: traffic moved off canary, restart confirmed, metrics trending normal

support-bot: Notified affected customers via templated message id: template-quotathrottle-v1. CS contact list: cust-101, cust-202, cust-303.

priya: handing off to doug for postmortem + remediation (code rollback + tests). I'll remain available until 16:00 UTC. Dougs please capture: logs, exact impacted customer list, repro steps for double-count.

doug: ack — taking over PD-63192. steps I'll run:
1) open incident doc (wiki) and paste timeline
2) collect ledger dump for canary shard 15:15->15:30 UTC
3) run local replay with v2 accounting to reproduce double-count
4) PR revert and link to failing test

priya: quick note on customer impact severity: showed as transient 3-6 minutes for most; two customers had repeated hits — assigned priority to reach out for post-incident follow-up.

maria: CS will send tailored post-incident note and offer support call if needed.

jordan: saving artifacts: /mnt/logs/quota-enforcer/2442001234/ledger-sample.json and metrics snapshot: s3://redwood-ops/incident-dumps/PD-63192/

priya: leaving oncall. handoff to doug. please escalate to eng-platform if we need more infra changes.

doug: thanks — I'll run the full postmortem and assign owners for fix+tests. updating PD ticket now.

deploy-bot: PD-63192 state -> acknowledged -> in_progress.

priya: :white_check_mark: mitigation verified, leaving.

support-bot: Ticket updates posted to customer threads and internal #incident-updates channel.

doug: (post-handoff) initial guess: missing dedupe in streaming accounting hook in v2 middleware. plan: revert, add dedupe by request_id, add integration test that replays a streaming chunk sequence.

priya: closing pager oncall handoff. thanks everyone.
